notes: Derived from git show v6.09 (package.json v6.09.0, METEOR@2.2, aldeed:simple-schema@1.5.4, aldeed:collection2@2.10.0, matb33:collection-hooks@0.9.1, wekan-cfs-* bundled packages, cfs-gridfs Npm mongodb 2.2.9 + gridfs-stream 1.1.1). Collection names: boards, swimlanes, lists, cards, checklists, checklistItems, card_comments, customFields, activities, users (Meteor.users); attachments via CollectionFS FS.Collection('attachments') => filerecords in 'cfs.attachments.filerecord', file bytes in GridFS root 'cfs_gridfs.attachments' => 'cfs_gridfs.attachments.files' + 'cfs_gridfs.attachments.chunks' (or on disk when ATTACHMENTS_STORE_PATH was set, FS.Store.FileSystem, with GridFS as read fallback). Avatars use the same mechanism: 'cfs.avatars.filerecord' + 'cfs_gridfs.avatars.files/.chunks'. Transient upload chunks live in 'cfs._tempstore.chunks' (CollectionFS TempStore) and may be left over. All Meteor ids are 17-char Random strings; only GridFS files/chunks use ObjectId. DIFFERENCES vs current WeKan: (1) Attachments are CollectionFS, not Meteor-Files: no 'attachments' collection with name/extension/extensionWithDot/versions.original.path/meta{boardId,cardId}; instead filerecord has original{name,type,size,updatedAt}, copies.attachments{name,type,size,key(GridFS ObjectId hex STRING),updatedAt,createdAt}, top-level boardId/swimlaneId/listId/cardId/userId, uploadedAt (set only when upload finished; records without uploadedAt/copies are incomplete uploads). Non-image files have copies.attachments.type forced to 'application/octet-stream' by beforeWrite while original.type keeps the real MIME. Linked-card uploads carry only boardId/cardId (no listId/swimlaneId). Imported filerecords briefly have source:'import' (then $unset). GridFS chunkSize is 2097152 (2MB), files doc has md5/aliases/metadata:null; the cfs init created an index {files_id:1,n:1} on the wrong collection 'cfs_gridfs.attachments' (no .chunks). (2) cards.coverId is the CollectionFS filerecord _id (set automatically only for images); '' when none. (3) lists.swimlaneId defaults to '' (lists shared by all swimlanes) - only template boards set a real swimlaneId; lists.sort/swimlanes.sort optional (may be missing on old/imported data); lists have starred, wipLimit{value,enabled,soft} optional object, type 'list'|'template-list'; lists.modifiedAt only set on insert, updatedAt tracks updates. (4) No width/collapsed/showAtMinicard etc. on lists, no per-swimlane list widths. (5) boards.members is [{userId,isAdmin,isActive,isNoComments,isCommentOnly,isWorker}] - no isNormalAssignedOnly/isCommentAssignedOnly/isReadOnly/isReadAssignedOnly; removed members stay with isActive:false. boards.permission only 'public'|'private'. boards.labels has NO default labels on new boards (autoValue commented out) so labels may be absent/empty; label {_id (6-char Random), name, color}. boards.type 'board'|'template-board'|'template-container'; each user has a 'template-container' board referenced from users.profile.templatesBoardId. boards.sort default -1 then lastBoard.sort+1; orgs/teams arrays optional; color from ALLOWED_BOARD_COLORS (default 'belize'); stars counter; many allows* booleans (no allowsBadge*/allowsShowListsAtMinicard etc.). (6) cards: members/assignees are arrays of userId strings; labelIds array; customFields [{_id,value}]; type 'cardType-card' (also 'cardType-linkedCard','cardType-linkedBoard','template-card'); listId/boardId/parentId/linkedId/coverId/requestedBy/assignedBy default ''; sort default 0; subtaskSort -1; cardNumber 0 unless board.allowsCardNumber; spentTime 0; isOvertime false; dateLastActivity; vote/poker sub-objects are schema-optional but simple-schema 1.5.4 applies nested defaultValues on insert, so cards created by 6.09 most likely carry vote{question:'',positive:[],negative:[],end:null,public:false,allowNonBoardMembers:false} and poker{question:false,one..unsure:[],end:null,allowNonBoardMembers:false} - but cards may also lack them (card C609B shows that shape). Gantt fields targetId_gantt/linkType_gantt/linkId_gantt arrays. No receivedAt/startAt/dueAt/endAt unless set. (7) checklists: {cardId,title,sort,createdAt,modifiedAt,finishedAt?} - before.insert also sets userId (not in schema; may or may not survive collection2 cleaning). No showAtMinicard/hideCheckedItems/hideAllItems. (8) checklistItems: {title,sort,isFinished,checklistId,cardId,createdAt,modifiedAt,userId?}. (9) card_comments: {boardId,cardId,text,createdAt,modifiedAt,userId}; reactions in separate cardCommentReactions. (10) customFields: boardIds array (not boardId), type in text/number/date/dropdown/checkbox/currency/stringtemplate, settings object always present (may be {}), showOnCard/automaticallyOnCard/alwaysOnCard/showLabelOnMiniCard/showSumAtTopOfList. (11) activities: no schema; createdAt/modifiedAt via hook; fields vary by activityType (createBoard has type:'board' + activityTypeId; addAttachment has type:'card', attachmentId = filerecord _id, attachmentName). (12) swimlanes: {title,archived,boardId,createdAt,sort?,color?,updatedAt,modifiedAt,type:'swimlane'|'template-container'}; default swimlane titled 'Default' (or translated 'default') created lazily by getDefaultSwimline.
